definitions.explanation: Housing that a company owns or rents and provides to its employees, usually at low rent; often an apartment building where many employees' families live.

examples.japanese: {社宅|しゃたく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
{社宅|しゃたく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}くて→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{助|たす}かる→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧。
examples.english: Company housing helps because the rent is cheap.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まり→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{社宅|しゃたく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧ことになった。
examples.english: I was transferred, so the family is moving into company housing in Osaka.

notes:
Company housing has long been a typical benefit at large Japanese firms, especially for employees who are transferred (⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社宅|しゃたく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧ / ⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to live in / move into company housing
- {借|か}り{上|あ}げ{社宅|しゃたく}: housing the company rents for employees

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{寮|りょう}→寮：03800_ryou⟧: dormitory (for single employees or students)
- {官舎|かんしゃ}: government housing for public servants
